name: cleanroom_r2e_rhea128_to141_external_v2
replacement_reason: Pre-reveal provenance audit proved that clean2023 uses direction-specific RHEA_ID plus alias-only protein mapping, not MASTER_ID plus exact protein IDs. V2 fixes identifier semantics without using release141 labels or model scores.

source_snapshots.pair_identity: RHEA_ID + ID before mapping; protein aliases are then mapped unambiguously into the frozen candidate universe while RHEA_ID remains direction-specific

training_source_alignment.protein_aliases: data/catalyst_candidate_universes/general_merged/protein_metadata.csv aliases field, semicolon-separated; ambiguous alias keys are unmapped
training_source_alignment.reaction_support: exact direction-specific reaction_id membership in drfp_categorical_rdkitplus_center_v1 entries
training_source_alignment.required_invariant: mapping compact2023 with these rules must exactly reproduce all 218537 clean2023 training pairs with zero missing and zero extra before target materialization

selection_without_model_scores.temporal_delta: mapped release141 pair is absent from mapped release128 pair set
selection_without_model_scores.clean_boundary: pair is absent from clean2023 and both mapped protein and direction-specific reaction entities are absent from clean2023 training entities
selection_without_model_scores.query_rule: every mapped release141 positive protein for an eligible reaction inside the fixed universe must be protein-cold versus clean2023
selection_without_model_scores.positive_labels: all mapped release141 positives inside the frozen 185918-protein universe for an eligible query

minimum_support_rule.if_below_minimum: underpowered_external_descriptive; do not relax mapping, delta, coldness or support rules

post_reveal_policy: No change to identifier mapping, releases, query inclusion, candidate support, fixed models or pass rule is allowed after release141 associations are extracted/read. Failed or underpowered remains failed/underpowered.
